items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: like Frank Buck bringing back alive

ctx.x: Yeah, when George Lewis was playing. Yeah, well that's why I was playing down there. In the 50's, in the early 50's. Yeah, yeah, I was playing down there with them, with Percy Humper and them. That was Percy's band? That was Percy's band. Syed was playing drum, Emma on piano, and I was playing, and Steve was playing clarinet, and it was something that happened that night, I don't know if, it's kind of sad, but it's true. People come and request, well they got this Terrence Smith, they, everywhere usually I play…

first he said I'm going to be taking all of them requests out there and get jammed up. So I said don't worry about it. So we was playing high society and the lady said don't play that. And she said why not? And I said your husband, I said you inquired all of this request and he stated that well they got into a little discussion between the two husband and wife. So a lady said play high society and he said that's my number. He said we'll play it for him then. So we played it for him and then afterwards she said, I…
You killed him with that song. His wife requested. It wasn't your fault. I guess you must've been put in surprise too huh?
